card.body: Week 1 update: Four people have now responded to Sandya's note. Someone helped her navigate the corrections process. Her case is being processed. By election day, she may be on the register.

card.title: BALLOT FOLDING PROCEDURE
card.body:
After marking your preference, fold the ballot paper ONCE, vertically, to conceal your vote before placing it in the ballot box.

Do NOT fold the ballot more than once.
Do NOT fold the ballot horizontally.

The presiding officer will demonstrate the correct fold at your polling station.

lines.text: Once. Vertically. In half. The voice note was wrong.
